purpose: external acceptance instrument for the ProgressDesk core delivery
criteria: a non-delivered feature is split into exactly two ordinary features or ended in a towel
a cleanup that cannot finish ends in the red light and is not silently retried
POLICE classifies typed concrete violation observations and never authorizes or repairs
the owner can stop a project unconditionally, without POLICE and with a failing journal write, and reports confirmed versus unresolved termination honestly
a transport interruption resumes the same invocation and consumes no builder attempt
the absence of a rationale, an empty rationale and an unreadable rationale are three distinct recorded facts, and absence reaches SHARPENER
